recipe: V3 criteria-in-prompt, names only, no definitions, no importance weights, no score re-rendering (notes/2026-08-09__v3_audit_fable.md §5)
k_caveat: k=20 is the audit's §5 recommendation but it is UNCONFIRMED: the +.0113 k20-over-k10 lift was established on the cap_crowd SANDBOX cell and the designated CONFIRM cell (cap_finalist) came back -.0276 [-.058,+.003] P(>0)=.043 when its k20 checkpoint was finally harvested (2026-08-08). k in {10,20} is a wash with cell-specific sign -- do NOT read a V3-vs-bank gap smaller than ~.03 as real.
orig_chain: methods/dense/run_dense_standard.sh (no --selection_split -> trainer default 'test'), seed 42, out dir rm_out/
trainer_entry_reason: split fractions inside the stock 80/10/10 +-2%% gate
bank_source: closure/maps_batch1/cells.py load('nc_outcome') -- Layer-1 V+A matrix (the bank vat_stack_nc_outcome.json's `layer1_bank` arm used)

join.description: (docket, comment text) composite key; both sides built from the same nc_vat_sample.jsonl text field
join.assertion: y compared elementwise between the dense split CSV and the joined bank row; build aborts on any mismatch

byte_assertions: every emitted row's judgement equals the original split CSV row's
every emitted row's group equals the original split CSV row's
every emitted text ENDS WITH '\n' + the original text verbatim
original split CSV sha256 recorded in orig_split_sha256

block_placement_reason: long-text cell: the trainer and score_eval_dense_v4.py truncate the RIGHT side at max_len=1024, so an appended block would be silently deleted on exactly the long documents (audit §1.2)

block_placement_auto_check.note: total token count is placement-invariant; placement only decides whether the right-side truncation eats the block or the document tail

importance_protocol: TRAIN-ONLY GroupKFold(3) inside the dense train split, frozen HistGB (max_leaf_nodes=31, lr=.06, max_iter=400, early stopping) seed 0, permutation_importance roc_auc n_repeats=5 on the inner held-out fold, mean over folds

top_k_criteria.name: Actionable alternatives and drafting in public comments
Petitions for rulemaking — right to petition, content, and filing
APA notice‑and‑comment adequacy and reasoned decisionmaking
Administrative and respondent burden minimization and efficiency
Predictability, uniformity, and reduced uncertainty in compliance
Petition/application filings — content, format, and sufficiency
Coalition affiliation and breadth in sign‑on letters
Adds new, material information to the record

leakage_rules: importance ranked on the dense TRAIN split only (GroupKFold(3) inside it); eval/test rows never enter the ranking
criterion scores are label-blind Gemma-4-31B judge outputs, so they are safe to render on every split
y NEVER appears in a prompt
splits are the cell's own dense-standard split CSVs, read verbatim
